description: Shoulder-joint puncture for suspected septic arthritis. Exercises the upper end of the § 5 Abs. 2 factor ladder: a documented 'schwer' reason takes a line to the Höchstsatz and is capped there rather than rejected, and the Höchstsatz is read off the position's own band — 3.5 for the general band, 1.3 for the § 5 Abs. 4 laboratory band.

factor_expectations.note: 'schwer' takes the ladder straight to the band maximum. The factor is CAPPED at the Höchstsatz, not refused: § 5 Abs. 2 allows it and § 12 Abs. 3 is satisfied by the written reason, which is carried on the line.
Abschnitt M takes the § 5 Abs. 4 band, so its Höchstsatz is 1.3. The same 'schwer' severity that produced 3.5 above produces 1.3 here — proof that the ceiling is per band and not a global 3.5.
'mittel' is one rung, not the maximum: 2.3 + 0.3.
No justification names the consultation, so it stays at the Schwellenwert. A justification bound to one service must not raise the rest of the invoice.
The 'schwer' reason on the CRP is bound to lab_crp only and does not reach the blood count.
